aiResearchSummary.text: Forus Health is engaged in developing devices such as a toroidal source of illumination and an annular light source device for neonatal fundus cameras, both aimed at enhancing retinal imaging. Their research also includes an integrated apparatus for visual function testing, a self-correcting objective refractometry system, and a portable retinal imaging system for preterm infants. These efforts focus on improving detection and assessment of visual impairments and retinal conditions.
